notes.title: Version 1.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]We’re tending to our garden by bringing you new challenges, better performance, and a bug-free Primrows experience![/p][list][*][p]Smoother transitions between menus and gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Streamlined challenges to reduce and memory usage and reduce loading times when switching between main menu and gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for additional weekly and monthly challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up several rules cards for existing challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Bug Fix: fixed visual bug where buttons would appear stuck in the pressed position[/p][/*][*][p]Bug Fix: fixed rare softlock when returning to main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Bug Fix: fixed watering and scoring animations on 3x3, 6x6, and 3x6 game boards[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]Eager to share your gardening prowess with the world?  This update brings you a crop of social and competitive features to show off your skills.[/p][p][/p][p]Full feature list:[/p][list][*][p]Added Leaderboard Support[/p][/*][*][p]Created 10 new achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Added A snapshot feature for sharing your high-scoring gardens[/p][/*][*][p]Refined tooltip system to better guide first-time players[/p][/*][*][p]Let players see scorecard tooltips by hovering with a mouse instead of clicking[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed “archive” to “replay”[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for additional weekly and monthly challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Bug Fix: fixed blur effect on backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]Bug Fix: cleaned up animations on Hexagonal and 3x3 challenge boards[/p][/*][*][p]Bug Fix: back button on the gameplay rules card takes you back to the correct spot in the menus[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p]We’ve been tending to our garden to bring you the best possible experience!  This patch fixes some bugs, adds some quality of life fixes, and expands support for ongoing challenges.[/p][list][*][p]Added support for upcoming weekly and monthly challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering over a score category while playing with a mouse now brings up the tooltip for that row, even when scoring is not currently enabled[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips have been reworked to provide better guidance to new players[/p][/*][*][p]Tile highlights appear for challenges with drag-and-drop flowers to assist players using a Steam Deck or other touch screen[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fix: score header no longer shows the wrong round number during score animations[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fix: scorecard will not let you record a second score while the score animation is playing out[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fix: glitchy scoring animations on certain challenge boards have been cleaned up[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fix: text overflow issues and overlapping flower tooltip emoji have been addressed[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fix: “new” badge on Challenges button now correctly appears when a new challenge is available[/p][/*][*][p]Added clarifying text to some weekly and monthly challenges[/p][/*][/list][p]
We’re still at work with additional improvements on the way, so if you have any bug reports or quality-of-life feature requests, please reach out to us on the official [u][url="https://discord.gg/WvHpHxczTA"]Primrows Discord[/url][/u].[/p]

notes.title: Tis' The Season for a Winter Update!
notes.notes:
[b][h3]It’s winter in Primrows![/h3][/b]
Coming back to work from a four day weekend, the dev team was greeted by the winter theme which will show up every year on December 1.  Hopefully this vibrant winter backyard puts you in the mood to curl up with your fluffiest blankets, a cup of hot cocoa, and a game of Primrows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110161/5b9833e31cf7484336a3ea33d24856a8c6352291.png[/img]

[b]Quality of life features[/b]

We’re currently in that long tail of the development where we’re trying to get all of those nice little quality of life features in place before launch.  The biggest addition from the past two weeks is a save and resume feature, so if you need to put Primrows down at any point, you’ll be able to pick up where you left off the next time you play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110161/34f8465b1727820131bb464bc9f3a8c95bdcaefd.png[/img]

[b]Flower Sneak Peek[/b]

Here’s a little taste of a feature we’ll be announcing coming up.  Our artist is working on these fun special flowers like hearts, lilies, and lotuses.  In good time we’ll reveal to you what these are for.  We think you’ll have fun with them!
